title: Losing the connection or the session mid-form

steps.do: Leave the form open longer than the sign-in timeout, then press Create quote.
steps.expect: You are asked to sign in; record whether the typing is kept.
steps.observed: Create quote after the timeout went to the sign-in page ("You were away for more than 60 minutes, so you were signed out. Sign in again to carry on where you were."); nothing was saved (0 quotations). After signing in again the app opened /quote-new; the typing was KEPT — the form refilled itself.
steps.reason: The test asks to record whether the typing is kept — there is no fixed answer.
steps.proposed: After signing in again the person should land back on the same form with everything they typed (the app already does this for a refused save — form_stash — but not across a timed-out session); until then, losing it should at least be warned about before the timeout.

steps.do: Turn off the network, press Save, turn it back on.
steps.expect: The browser shows an error; pressing Save again saves ONE quotation.
steps.observed: Offline: the browser showed its own error (chrome-error page), nothing saved (0 new); back online, Save again → exactly one quotation (the browser had kept the typing).

steps.do: Press the browser Back button after saving.
steps.observed: After saving (/quote?id=1), Back went to /quote-new#quoteform=terms; still 1 quotations — none added.
